title: Failure Diagnosis v1
description: An agent's reading of one failed phase, using the ARIS compute-env-contract layer vocabulary (spec/build/weights/resolution/exec) plus the two verdicts that decide what the platform does next: is this blocked by the environment rather than the code, and is another attempt worth making. Deliberately not a keyword classification: a regex table turns judgement into a maintenance list, and the symptom space here is open-ended. `reasoning` and `evidence` are what a human audits.

layer.description: Which layer is wrong, per compute-env-contract §5. 'code' means the generated program; 'plan' means the idea card or protocol itself, which no further generation will fix.

environmentBlocked.description: True when missing access, credentials, quota, networking, container or driver support is the cause. The repair budget must not be spent on it.

worthRetrying.description: False ends the refine loop early even if attempts remain, because repeating the same request would not change the verdict.

evidence.description: Quoted lines from the log the verdict rests on. A diagnosis without quoted evidence is a guess, so this is required.
